full_text: At 49, he beat surfers half his age. At the world's deadliest wave. Kelly Slater, a kid from Florida, became the youngest world surfing champion in history at 20. He won five more titles, retired at the top, and came back - to win five more in his thirties. At 39, he became the oldest world champion ever. He holds both ends of the record. Eleven world titles and fifty-six event wins - both all-time records. No other man has more than four titles. Time beats every athlete.
